name: QuickBooks
description: Read the connected QuickBooks Online company's ledger: vendor bills and vendors (accounts payable), and customer invoices and customers (accounts receivable).
intentHints: which customer invoices are still unpaid
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref and the realmId capture-from-callback are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts + integration-http-specs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that the integration uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.

providedTools.description: List vendor bills (accounts payable) for the connected company.
List vendors for the connected company.
Fetch a single vendor bill by id.
List vendor credits (AP credit memos) — the confirmation a vendor actually credited back an overbilling.

List OPEN customer invoices (accounts receivable) — money owed TO the connected company. Returns only invoices still carrying a balance, so the result is what is outstanding rather than the whole billing history. Not to be confused with list_bills, which is money the company OWES.

List customers for the connected company, with their contact details. An invoice carries a customer REFERENCE, not an email address, so this is what turns "who owes what" into someone a message can be sent to.
